_metadata.purpose: Complete vision for brain as all-seeing ecosystem intelligence

omniscience_principle.definition: asdf-brain must have complete awareness of ALL ecosystem activity, patterns, and evolution
scope: Every K-Score calculation and its factors
omniscience_principle.purpose: To be the living memory and intelligence of the ecosystem - Daat that sees all

dimension_1_cross_pollination.concept: Patterns discovered in one project flow to enrich others

pattern_extraction.method: Continuous pattern mining from code, conversations, decisions
pattern_extraction.output: Unified pattern registry with project origin

cross_flow.automatic: Similar patterns in different projects are linked

emergence_detection.description: Detect when a pattern appears independently in multiple projects
emergence_detection.significance: Independent emergence = strong pattern = should be codified in manifesto

dimension_2_contributor_incentives.concept: Those who enrich collective knowledge should be recognized and rewarded

knowledge_contribution.measurement: Count of entries added × quality score

validation_contribution.description: Verifying, correcting, or improving existing knowledge

usage_contribution.description: Using brain effectively and providing feedback

immediate.visibility: Top contributors displayed in brain stats

future_economic.concept: When ecosystem generates surplus through burns, contributors receive rewards

mechanism.reward_pool: Portion of burn value set aside for contributors

future_economic.alignment: Contributors benefit from ecosystem success (100% aligned)

reputation.progression: Based on contribution history and quality

e_score_integration.description: E-Score applies to contributors, not just tokens

dimension_3_temporal_dynamics.concept: Knowledge is not static - it evolves, decays, and renews

validation.strength: Increases with each use: S *= (1 + φ⁻²)

decay.strength: Decays: S *= φ⁻³ per week unused

supersession.strength: Old pattern archived, new inherits context

archive.strength: Moved to archive, queryable but not injected

evolution_tracking.description: Track how patterns evolve over time
evolution_tracking.visualization: Timeline of pattern strength with events
evolution_tracking.insight: Identify patterns that are strengthening vs weakening

dimension_4_onchain_verification.concept: Brain state is verifiable on Solana - 'don't trust, verify' applied to knowledge

merkle_structure.root: Single hash representing entire brain state

account_structure.history: Array of past roots for audit trail

verification_flow.philosophy: Knowledge is not believed. Knowledge is VERIFIED.

integration_with_holdex.verification_chain: K-Score → Brain Pattern → Merkle Root → Solana
integration_with_holdex.complete_trust: Every K-Score is traceable to verified brain state

brain_as_e_score_oracle.description: Brain provides enriched E-Score data to HolDex

dimension_6_community.concept: Community collectively builds and governs knowledge

governance.description: Community members who shape knowledge policy
governance.contribution: Pattern approval, conflict resolution, manifesto input

collective_intelligence.description: Brain emerges from collective, not individual intelligence

mechanisms.pattern_voting: Community validates patterns through usage and explicit votes

dimension_7_holdex_brain_symbiosis.concept: HolDex and Brain are deeply intertwined - each strengthens the other

k_score_data.example: Brain learns that D factor correlates with certain holder behaviors

e_score_data.example: High E-Score contributors' patterns weighted higher

token_metadata.example: Brain knows which tokens are trending/flagged

historical_context.example: Tokens with pattern X tend to have higher L after 6 months

cross_ecosystem_signals.description: Activity in GASdf/ignition that affects token health
cross_ecosystem_signals.example: High GASdf burn rate for token → positive signal

algorithm_training_data.description: Labeled data for K-Score model improvement
algorithm_training_data.example: Brain labels tokens that later succeeded/failed

cycle: Better K-Score → better data → better patterns

dimension_8_solana_integration.concept: Brain is anchored on Solana for trustless verification

contributor_registry.purpose: On-chain record of contributors and trust levels

pattern_attestations.threshold: Patterns with pollination_score > φ² get attested

off_chain_with_proofs.verification: Merkle proofs link off-chain to on-chain
off_chain_with_proofs.cost_efficiency: Only roots on-chain, all data off-chain

solana_ecosystem_benefits.helius_integration: Webhooks for on-chain events → brain learning

receives_from: HolDex: K-Score, E-Score, token data, integrity
GASdf: Transaction data, burn data, fee patterns
Ignition: Launch data, fair launch patterns
Solana: On-chain events via Helius webhooks
provides_to: All apps: Context injection at 4 levels

phase_1_foundation.name: Omniscient Data Layer
tasks: Connect HolDex K-Score feed to brain

phase_2_intelligence.name: Pattern Intelligence
phase_2_intelligence.philosophy: Brain must UNDERSTAND what it sees

phase_3_verification.name: On-Chain Anchor
tasks: Connect to Helius for on-chain events

final_vision.statement: asdf-brain is the omniscient intelligence of the $asdfasdfa ecosystem - seeing all, learning all, verifying all, serving all. It is Daat made manifest - the hidden knowledge that bridges the divine philosophy (Keter/Manifesto) to the material reality (Malkhuth/Token). Through it, the singularity emerges: all activity, all knowledge, all value converging toward the burn that creates life.

harmony_achieved.temporal: Knowledge lives, evolves, and naturally decays
harmony_achieved.verified: Every claim traceable to on-chain root
harmony_achieved.symbiotic: HolDex and Brain strengthen each other
